description: Preview one covariance-aware reduction of an existing verified linear exposure toward the owner volatility mandate. An optional target may tighten but never loosen that mandate. The result is bound to an exact Hyperliquid preview and never signs, funds, bridges, submits, changes a position, or moves money.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

asset.description: Canonical asset with an existing verified linear USD delta to reduce.

max_size_usd.description: Maximum current-position notional the preview may reduce.

observations.description: The same aligned daily returns used for historical risk, covering every verified linear delta asset.

asset_returns_pct.description: Canonical asset symbols mapped to bounded percentage changes.

date.description: Unique UTC observation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

target_portfolio_volatility_pct.description: Optional annualized volatility target from 0 to 100 percent. It may tighten but never loosen the owner mandate.

name: preview_covariance_risk_trim
